timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Interior timber flooring installation for new finishes and renovation projects. We assess the existing base, floor levels and selected boards before planning the installation.
timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 为新饰面及翻新项目安装室内木地板，规划安装前评估现有基层、地面高度与选定板材。

timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Timber floor preparation and board layout
timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 木地板基层准备与板材排布

timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: A timber floor starts with the base beneath it. Existing coverings, surface condition, moisture and floor levels affect the preparation and the installation system. We check the accessible base and discuss any removal or remedial work before laying new boards.
timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 木地板从下方基层开始。旧覆盖物、表面状况、潮湿和高度影响准备及安装系统。铺新板前检查可接触基层，并讨论拆除或修复需求。

timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Board dimensions, laying direction and doorway transitions influence the finished appearance. Tell us which rooms are involved, whether the property is occupied and whether you have selected or purchased the material. We confirm the product requirements, supply responsibility and installation method for your floor.
timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 板材尺寸、铺设方向和门口过渡影响最终外观。请说明房间范围、是否仍居住，以及是否已选购材料。我们确认产品要求、供料责任及安装方式。

timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: The room area, existing floor removal, base preparation, board format and access affect the installation quote. Tell us about furniture, adjoining finishes and when the space is available. We identify the preparation and finishing details included before work begins.
timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 房间面积、旧地板拆除、基层准备、板材规格及通行影响报价。请告知家具、相邻饰面和空间可施工时间。开工前明确包含的准备及收尾细节。

timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.source: Installation and return-to-use timing depend on the selected product and site conditions. Follow the care instructions for the installed floor, including suitable cleaning methods and protection when moving furniture. We confirm these details for your material rather than applying tile-care instructions to timber.
timber-flooring-adelaide.html/html[1]/bo.target: 安装与恢复使用取决于产品和现场条件。遵循地板保养说明，包括适当清洁和搬家具时的保护。我们按您的材料确认要求，不把瓷砖保养方法套用到木材。
